textRuns.value: Timetables: Adelaide Metro (Department for Infrastructure and Transport, South Australia), Transport Victoria, Transport for NSW and Translink (Department of Transport and Main Roads, Queensland) GTFS feeds for Wednesday 25 and Sunday 29 November 2026 (CC BY 4.0).
